messages.subject: [rkward-users] [rkward - Help] Package problems under Gutsy
messages.body_plain:
Read and respond to this message at: 
https://sourceforge.net/forum/message.php?msg_id=4877239
By: leczar

Whenever I try to install new packages, I end up with an error. I am using the
Settings>Configure Packages>Install path, end I am trying to install to
/usr/lib/R/library. I am being asked for my root password and log in as such.
I am getting several error messages like this (in this case, it is the "Hmisc"
package)

* Installing *source* package 'maps' ...
** libs
** arch - 
gcc-4.2 -std=gnu99 -g -O2    Gmake.c   -o Gmake
/bin/bash: gcc-4.2: command not found
make: *** [Gmake] Error 127
ERROR: compilation failed for package 'maps'
** Removing '/usr/lib/R/library/maps'

and in the end

The downloaded packages are in
	/tmp/Rtmp0PhefW/downloaded_packages
There were 17 warnings (use warnings() to see them)
>
system ("chown username /home/username/.rkward/package_archive/*")
chown: cannot access `/home/username/.rkward/package_archive/*': No such file
or directory
> q ()

Any idea what I do wrong?

messages.subject: [rkward-users] editor window loses focus after execution (with autocompletion)
messages.subject_clean: [rkward-users] editor window loses focus after execution (with autocompletion)
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I'm using rkward 0.4.8 (Using KDE 3.5.6) on Ubuntu 7.04 Feisty Fawn. I
think it's really great software, there's just one annoying thing which
I'm struggling with:
When running a statement created by autocompletion (and the tooltip is
still visible), the editor window loses focus after completion of the
statement, which has the consequences that copy/paste goes to the
console window and no scripts can be executed anymore. My unsatisfying
workaround is klicking a few times between console and editor window. Is
there a way get rid of this problem?

thx,
Albert

messages.subject_clean: [rkward-users] editor window loses focus after execution (with autocompletion)
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

On Sunday 20 April 2008, Albert Greinoecker wrote:
> I'm using rkward 0.4.8 (Using KDE 3.5.6) on Ubuntu 7.04 Feisty Fawn. I
> think it's really great software, there's just one annoying thing which
> I'm struggling with:
> When running a statement created by autocompletion (and the tooltip is
> still visible), the editor window loses focus after completion of the
> statement, which has the consequences that copy/paste goes to the
> console window and no scripts can be executed anymore. My unsatisfying
> workaround is klicking a few times between console and editor window. Is
> there a way get rid of this problem?

various focus problems have been around for quite some time. Some have been 
fixed at one time or another (so you might try 0.4.9a to see if there is any 
improvement), but it's never been quite perfect.

Things seem to have improved considerably in the KDE 4 port (versions 0.5.0 
and above), so if you can install that, this will probably solve the issue 
(you can run rkward 0.5.0 in a KDE 3.5.x session, you only need to have the 
KDE 4 libraries installed).

Regards
Thomas
